name: Gather Storyline Leads in the Tavern
description: A new adventurer should begin by speaking with the tavern regulars and gathering the strongest leads before leaving the Gilded Tankard.

objectives.description: Speak to Eldric and gather his storyline lead.
objectives.next_step: Talk to Eldric in The Gilded Tankard and ask what work or danger he knows about.

completion_criteria.description: Complete when Eldric's storyline lead has been added to the journal.

objectives.description: Speak to Marta the Scholar and gather her storyline lead.
objectives.next_step: Talk to Marta the Scholar in The Gilded Tankard and ask what problem needs help.

completion_criteria.description: Complete when Marta's storyline lead has been added to the journal.
